notes: Statement: the DWITE February 2009 problem 4 page (dwite.ca/questions/wiring_the_server_room.html, Wayback snapshot of 2009-02-24); it shows only the first two of the five maps as the sample, and orig.cpp reads maps until end of input so that sample runs. No C++ submission exists and the only AC (3659678, JS) prints five fixed numbers, so orig.cpp is a Held-Karp reference written for the port; it matches an exhaustive permutation brute on 300 random inputs of up to 8 nodes per map.
